title: When You Seek Me with All Your Heart
story:
A young boy once lost a small gift that was very special to him.

He searched his room quickly, looking under the bed and behind the furniture.

When he could not find it, he almost gave up.

His grandmother encouraged him to slow down and search carefully.

He looked through every drawer, checked every corner, and finally found the gift inside an old box.

The boy realized that finding something precious sometimes requires more than a quick search.

It requires attention, patience, and determination.

Seeking God can be like that.

God does not want us to seek Him only when we need something.

He invites us to seek Him with our whole heart.

When we sincerely turn toward Him, He promises that we will find Him.

There may be distractions, doubts, and busy days that make it difficult to focus on God.

But when we intentionally seek Him through prayer, His Word, worship, and obedience, our relationship with Him grows deeper.

God is not hiding from those who sincerely seek Him.

He wants us to know Him and draw closer to Him with our whole heart.
life_lesson: God promises to reveal Himself to those who sincerely seek Him. Seek Him wholeheartedly, not only when you need His help.
prayer:
Dear Heavenly Father,

I want to seek You with all my heart.

Forgive me for the times I allow distractions and other things to become more important than knowing You.

Help me to desire Your presence and to spend time in Your Word and in prayer.

Give me a heart that truly longs for You.

Thank You for promising that when I seek You sincerely, I will find You.

Draw me closer to You each day.

In Jesus' name,
Amen.
reflection_question:
Are you seeking God only when you need something from Him?

What can you do today to seek Him more sincerely?

Is there anything distracting you from giving God your whole heart?
verse: You will seek Me and find Me when you seek Me with all your heart.
